pitch_routes.route: The Walt Disney Company's policy is not to accept any unsolicited creative ideas or submissions. Approach through an established production company or agent.

briefs.title: Series Mania: Angela Jain makes Disney+ spending commitment (Broadcast)
briefs.summary: Disney+ EMEA will raise unscripted spend proportionally more than scripted. It wants 'unscripted thrillers' (anthology one-off docs, obs docs and reality formats, including in the UK), unscripted in volume, and more UK commissioning. Orders depend on the country rather than a fixed shopping list.

briefs.title: Sean Doyle lays out commissioning plans (Broadcast)
briefs.summary: Expanding into reality and formats, starting with Blind Date. Continuing female-skewing obs docs and limited series, adding male-skewing sports docs later, and returning series alongside premium boxset docs. Story comes before talent.
